### Calendula Flowers – 70g | Pure, Sun-Dried Petals for Traditional Use

Experience the gentle beauty of 100% Authentic Calendula Flowers, carefully hand-harvested and sun-dried to preserve their natural essence. Sourced from trusted organic farms, these vibrant golden petals are traditionally valued in Ayurvedic practices for their soothing qualities and natural aroma.

Ideal for use in herbal infusions, external applications, and traditional formulations, Calendula Flowers are a cherished botanical in holistic wellness rituals. Their natural color and delicate fragrance make them a popular choice for preparing herbal oils, pastes, and bath preparations in line with time-honored customs.

Why Choose Our Calendula Flowers?
- Pure & Unadulterated: No additives, no chemicals, no synthetic processing.
- Sun-Dried for Authenticity: Gently dried under natural sunlight to retain natural properties.
- Traditional Use: Used in age-old preparations for skin care rituals and herbal remedies.
- Natural Aroma & Color: Each batch may vary slightly in hue due to natural growing conditions — a sign of authenticity.

Storage Tip: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Use within 12 months of opening for best quality.

Note: This product is not intended for medical use. Individual experiences may vary based on personal habits, preparation methods, and lifestyle. Always consult a qualified practitioner before incorporating into your routine.
